name: Lima
summary: Lima combines one of the most celebrated food scenes in the world with a cost of living well below that of European capitals, ideal for digital nomads on a tight budget. Miraflores, San Isidro and Barranco offer coworkings, cafes with good Wi-Fi and views of the Pacific from the Costa Verde boardwalk. Safety varies greatly depending on the area: these neighborhoods are noticeably quieter than the rest of the city.
